column1: 22449§notorious§nəʊˈtɔːriəs§Tom was a notorious liar.§汤姆是一个**声名狼藉**的骗子。§
22450§cash§kæʃ§You can withdraw cash from a cashpoint machine with a cashcard.§你可以用提款卡在取款机上提取**现金**。§
22451§valid§ˈvælɪd§You don't want to get to your destination only to find you have the wrong visa, or worse, that your passport isn't valid any more.§你不会想要等到了目的地却发现你带的是错误的签证，或者更糟糕的是，你的护照不再**有效**。§
22452§enrich§ɪnˈrɪtʃ§Ports can enrich the life of a city.§港口可以**丰富**一座城市的生活。§
22453§equation§ɪˈkweɪʒn§The researchers thought that human beings should not be left out of the equation in the rainforest.§研究人员认为，不应该忽略人类在雨林的生态**平衡**中的作用。§
22454§miracle§ˈmɪrəkl§The doctor said that Mary's recovery was a miracle.§医生说玛丽能够康复是个**奇迹**。§
22455§worthy§ˈwɜːði§I would praise him, but he is not worthy.§我想表扬他，但他不**值得**。§改译文：原译「不争气」是意译，括不出 worthy（值得的），改为「不值得」
22456§irrigation§ˌɪrɪˈgeɪʃn§The sea water is too salty to be used for the irrigation of crops.§海水太咸了，不能用于农作物**灌溉**。§
22457§chief§tʃiːf§Paula is the chief counsellor at Liverpool's famous pain clinic.§波拉是利物浦著名的疼痛治疗诊所的**首席**顾问。§
22458§remedy§ˈremədi§Without remedies, the two men who ate poisonous mushrooms died within days.§由于没有**药物**，那两个吃了毒蘑菇的人几天后就死了。§改例句：可数名词 mushroom 前无冠词，应用复数 mushrooms
22459§accelerate§əkˈseləreɪt§The leader lost ground as the rest of the runners accelerated.§领先者在其余赛跑者**加速**时逐渐失去了优势。§
22460§thoughtful§ˈθɔːtfl§It's so thoughtful of you to offer to drop me off at the train station.§你主动提出开车送我去火车站，真是太**体贴**了。§
22461§brunt§brʌnt§The brunt of a typhoon can be abated by the breakwaters.§防浪堤可以缓解台风的**冲击力**。§

22462§prominence§ˈprɒmɪnəns§Giving prominence to characteristics and increasing innovation is a pillar for enterprise's further development.§**突出**特色和勇于创新是企业进一步发展的支柱。§改例句：可数名词 characteristic 单数不能单独使用，改为复数 characteristics
22463§compass§ˈkʌmpəs§Nearly two thousand years have passed since the invention of the compass, which is the pride of Chinese people.§**指南针**的发明是中国人的骄傲，距今已有差不多两千年的历史。§改例句：可数名词单数 compass 前缺冠词，补 the

22464§inaugurate§ɪˈnɔːgjəreɪt§The officials said more subway lines would be inaugurated to facilitate the public in the next two years.§政府官员称，在未来两年中，将**建成**更多地铁线路以方便大众出行。§改例句：说的是未来两年，in the recent two years 用词错，改为 in the next two years

22465§suppress§səˈpres§I know life is hard for you, so don't suppress the tears, as tears on the face are better than hurt to heart.§我知道你的生活很艰难，所以不要**强忍**泪水，脸上流泪总好过内心受伤。§改例句：hard to you 应为 hard for you；主语 tears 是复数，is 改为 are
22466§perpetuate§pəˈpetʃueɪt§The pressure from the pain, when used correctly, can dispel fear and perpetuate motive power.§源自痛苦的压力，如果运用得当，能驱散恐惧并使动力**持久**。§

22467§configuration§kənˌfɪgəˈreɪʃn§This seminar aims to introduce the configuration and composition of the papain and the use in foodstuff, medicine and industry.§本次研讨会旨在介绍木瓜蛋白酶的**结构**、组成，及其在食品、医药和工业中的用途。§改例句：表示「组成」应为名词 composition，composing 用词错

22468§replenish§rɪˈplenɪʃ§The plunge of oil is crippling the government's ability to replenish its gold and foreign-currency reserves, just when it needs them most.§油价下跌正在削弱政府**补给**黄金和外汇储备的能力，而现在正是它最需要这些的时候。§

22469§encompass§ɪnˈkʌmpəs§It would not worry trustbusters, because it seems unlikely to encompass advertising area in any deal between the New York Post and the Daily News.§《纽约邮报》和《每日新闻》之间的任何合作似乎都不可能**包含**广告领域，因此反垄断人士不会担心。§
22470§camouflage§ˈkæməflɑːʒ§Her size was properly camouflaged by the long loose dress she wore in the evening party.§晚宴上，她一席宽松的长裙恰到好处地**掩饰**了自己的体形。§

22471§encapsulate§ɪnˈkæpsjuleɪt§The movie encapsulated tens of romantic stories and recomposed them, which grasped many youths' eyes.§这部电影**收纳**了数十个浪漫故事，并将其改编，引起大量年轻人的关注。§改例句：many 后应为复数所有格 youths'，youth's 错

22472§reinvigorate§ˌriːɪnˈvɪgəreɪt§To reinvigorate the rural economy, the government proposes to exploit more highways to connect villages nationwide.§为促进农村经济**振兴**，政府计划在全国范围内建设更多的乡间公路。§改例句：nationwide 是副词，in the nationwide 语法错，删去 in the

22473§repatriate§ˌriːˈpætrieɪt§Some western nations were hit hard by the global financial crisis in late 2008, and tried to repatriate migrant workers to their own countries.§一些西方国家在2008下半年受到全球金融危机的重创，因此想方设法将外籍劳工**遣送回国**。§改例句：一般过去时不能和 since 连用，since 改为 in；financial crisis 前缺冠词，补 the
22474§tensile§ˈtensaɪl§The cables, made of high tensile steel, are the bridge's main support.§这种具有高**抗拉**强度的钢索是这座大桥的主要支撑。§
22475§solidify§səˈlɪdɪfaɪ§In either case, make it a habit of solidifying your thoughts in a pattern before you put it into practice.§在任何情况下，都要养成一个习惯：先使想法**固化**成一种模式，再着手实践。§

22476§propagate§ˈprɒpəgeɪt§Those false television advertisements on medicine, with the famous as their spokesman, had propagated a false image in the public.§那些由名人代言的虚假医药电视广告在公众中**宣传**了一种虚假形象。§改例句：advertising 不可数，不能和 Those 连用，改为 advertisements
22477§germinate§ˈdʒɜːmɪneɪt§The cat puts many fishes, which she has caught, in the soil in order to germinate them and pray for a good harvest in next year.§小猫把它捉来的很多鱼种到地里，希望它们**发芽**生长，并祈祷来年获得大丰收。§

22478§unbeatable§ʌnˈbiːtəbl§The emerging market, with great curiosity about new things, has unbeatable advantage to grasp the investor's eyes.§新兴市场更容易接受新事物，在吸引投资方面拥有**绝对**优势。§改例句：great 后应接名词，curious 改为 curiosity

22479§accredit§əˈkredɪt§Scolded by the boss many times, the young man was accredited as department manager, which is a surprise for everybody.§这个多次被老板训斥的年轻人却**荣升**部门经理，这让所有人都始料不及。§改例句：many times 前不加 for；suddenness 用词错，改为 surprise
22480§disorientate§dɪsˈɔːriənteɪt§The woman felt shocked and totally disorientated by her mother's crazy behaviour.§这个女人因其母亲的疯狂举动而感到震惊不已，**不知所措**。§
22481§slumber§ˈslʌmbə(r)§To enjoy the beauty of cherry blossom, many foreigners visit Mount Fuji which has slumbered for years.§为了一睹樱花盛放之美，很多国外游客前往**休眠**多年的富士山游览。§改例句：Mount Fuji 前不加冠词，删去 the
22482§sufficient§səˈfɪʃnt§It takes only 10 to 20 minutes of exposure to sunlight a day to ensure sufficient vitamin D production.§一天只需接受10到20分钟的阳光照射便可使身体产生**足够**的维生素D。§
22483§antiquity§ænˈtɪkwəti§No one knows how much antiquity has been stolen or destroyed.§没人知道有多少**古迹**被偷盗或毁坏了。§
22484§pretend§prɪˈtend§Many people pretend that they understand modern art.§很多人都**假装**自己懂得现代艺术。§
22485§dominant§ˈdɒmɪnənt§The dominant idea, raised by 64% of the pupils, was that rainforests provide animals with habitats.§64%的学生提出的**主流**观点是，热带雨林为动物提供了栖息地。§
22486§pilot§ˈpaɪlət§They owed their lives to the skill of the pilots.§是**飞行员**的技术挽救了他们的生命。§
22487§privacy§ˈprɪvəsi§Biometrics raise thorny questions about privacy and the potential for abuse.§生物测验学会引发一些有关**隐私**的棘手问题，同时它还很可能会被滥用。§改译文：删去句末排版残留「绝）」
22488§advance§ədˈvɑːns§It is essential to reserve a computer three days in advance if you want to use one.§如果你想使用电脑，最好**提前**三天预订。§
22489§efficiency§ɪˈfɪʃnsi§Clean coal is an avenue for improving fuel conversion efficiency.§提高煤的纯度是提高燃料转换**效率**的一个途径。§
22490§drainage§ˈdreɪnɪdʒ§Drainage within and off the mining site is carefully designed.§矿井内部及周围的**排水系统**都是经过精心设计的。§
22491§credible§ˈkredəbl§This witness presented credible information to convict the defendant.§这个证人提供了**可靠**的证据，证明被告有罪。§
22492§elaborate§ɪˈlæbərət§Archaeological traces of far more elaborate cultures have been dismissed in this region.§排除了该地区有更为**复杂**和高级文明存在的考古遗迹的可能。§
22493§consult§kənˈsʌlt§You do not need to consult your doctor immediately if the tablets give you a side-effect.§如果药片对你产生副作用，不必立即**咨询**医生。§改译文：原译「请医生诊治」括不出 consult（请教，咨询），改为「咨询医生」
22494§fare§feə(r)§According to Susan, air fares are the lowest.§据苏珊说，机票**价格**是最便宜的。§
22495§foundation§faʊnˈdeɪʃn§Most of the rocks will become the foundations for the airport's runways and taxiways.§大多数石块将用作铺设机场跑道和飞机滑行道的**地基**。§
22496§principal§ˈprɪnsəpl§The Yellow River is one of the principal rivers of Asia.§黄河是亚洲的**主要**河流之一。§
22497§collection§kəˈlekʃn§The textile collection of the museum is the largest in the world.§这家博物馆**收藏**的纺织品是全世界最多的。§
22498§comparatively§kəmˈpærətɪvli§The standard of living in this city is comparatively high.§这个城市的生活水平**相对**比较高。§
22499§victim§ˈvɪktɪm§The majority of the victims in this earthquake were children.§这次地震中的主要**受害者**是儿童。§
22500§aisle§aɪl§In the supermarket, the end of an aisle is usually used for promoting special offers.§超市**过道**的尽头常用来促销特价商品。§
22501§scan§skæn§Customers at some banks will have to present their faces for scanning before they can enter the building.§某些银行需要客户经过面部**扫描**才可以进入。§

22502§sculpture§ˈskʌlptʃə(r)§Tom now has a new commission—making a glass sculpture for the headquarters of a pizza company.§现在汤姆有了新任务：为一家披萨公司总部的建筑制作一个玻璃**雕像**。§改例句：head-quarters 是排版断行残留，应为 headquarters
22503§rigorous§ˈrɪgərəs§Once you have arrived at your hypothesis, you then proceed through a strictly logical and rigorous process.§一旦你提出了假设，你就可以进行一个逻辑性极强的**严密**的求证过程。§
22504§fragment§ˈfrægmənt§The gigantic explosion from eruption of the volcano tore its summit into fragments.§火山喷发引起的强烈爆炸将山顶炸成了**碎片**。§
22505§audio§ˈɔːdiəʊ§Teams of typists transcribed the audio tapes to produce a computerised database of ten million words.§一组组打字员把**录音**磁带转录下来，制成包含一千万个单词的电脑数据库。§改译文：书上把 audio tapes 译成「声音录入组…磁带」，词没对上
22506§landmark§ˈlændmɑːk§In fact, I'd just like to spend a few minutes pointing out some of the landmarks that can be seen from here.§事实上，我只是想花几分钟时间指出从这里能看到的一些**地标**。§
22507§biography§baɪˈɒgrəfi§He found a career entirely devoted to biography.§他找了一份专门从事**传记**创作的职业。§

22508§dubious§ˈdjuːbiəs§The greatly respected American Association of Zoological Parks and Aquariums (AAZPA) has had extremely dubious members, too.§在备受人们尊敬的美国动物园和水族馆协会中，也有一些身份极其**可疑**的成员。§改例句：中文括号改为英文括号
22509§boulder§ˈbəʊldə(r)§The boulder is too big to put into the cave.§**石头**太大了，塞不进洞里。§
22510§drill§drɪl§This small hole was drilled with an auger.§这个小洞是用钻孔机**钻**出来的。§
22511§batch§bætʃ§The batch number is printed on the bottom of each jar.§每个罐子的瓶底都印有生产**批**号。§
22512§shell§ʃel§Anne removed the oyster from its shell and began to eat.§安妮从**壳**里挖出牡蛎，吃了起来。§
22513§subsidy§ˈsʌbsədi§In the rich countries, the annual value of farm subsidies is immense—about $250 billion.§在经济发达国家，每年的农业**津贴**都高达约2,500亿美元。§
22514§contrived§kənˈtraɪvd§The story is really touching, but the ending is rather contrived.§这个故事确实感人，但结尾颇有**斧凿**之嫌。§
22515§multiply§ˈmʌltɪplaɪ§Hot weather multiplies bacteria rapidly.§炎热的天气导致细菌迅速**繁殖**。§

22516§joint§dʒɔɪnt§The Universities of Oxford and Cambridge recently held joint conferences to discuss the rapid decline in literacy among their undergraduates.§牛津大学和剑桥大学近日召开**联合**会议，讨论两校大学生文化素养迅速下降的问题。§
22517§spray§spreɪ§Farmers are spraying the crops with pesticide.§农民们正在给庄稼**喷洒**杀虫剂。§
22518§meanwhile§ˈmiːnwaɪl§Tina's due to arrive on Sunday. Meanwhile, what do we do?§蒂娜定于星期天到，**这期间**我们做什么呢？§
22519§force§fɔːs§She'd like to finish the studies she was forced to give up earlier in life.§她想完成自己早年**被迫**放弃的研究。§
22520§evolve§ɪˈvɒlv§According to brain researchers, as the brain evolved, one side became specialised for fine control of movement.§根据大脑研究人员的说法，随着大脑的**进化**，一边的脑半球专门用来精确控制动作。§
